context.scope: Single-merchant demonstration drawn from the local Shopify export. Includes only the supplied products and variants; completeness against the live store is unmeasured. Product categories require separate review.

measurement.denominator_unit: expanded listings; one row for an unexpanded input record
measurement.interval_method: Wilson 95%; descriptive catalogue counts, not accuracy
measurement.floor_basis: Most-published observed selection axis; otherwise most-published structured product attribute. Suggestion only; reviewer must select the floor.
warnings: human_review_required: catalogue frequency cannot establish the category's necessary attributes
